title: Productivity, profitability and financial performance
authors: Giulio Bottazzi; Angelo Secchi; Federico Tamagni
primary_question: How persistent are productivity and profitability differences, how do financial conditions interact with them, and do better-performing firms grow faster?
method_family: Kernel densities; non-parametric stochastic comparisons; autoregressive persistence; parametric and non-parametric production analysis; growth correlations
p2_role: CORE_MOTIVATION: persistent heterogeneous micro states and weak selection; supports stable subpopulation differences but does not derive aggregate volatility

title: Corporate performance and market selection: Some comparative evidence
authors: Giulio Bottazzi; Giovanni Dosi; Nadia Jacoby; Angelo Secchi; Federico Tamagni
venue_or_series: LEM Working Paper 2009/13; later Industrial and Corporate Change
primary_question: Do productivity and profitability differences translate into differential firm growth and market selection across Italy and France?
method_family: Binned statistics; kernel regression; firm fixed-effects panel regressions; contemporaneous and multi-year comparisons
p2_role: CORE_MOTIVATION: cross-country evidence that micro heterogeneity persists while systematic growth links are weak; fixed effects dominate much growth variation

title: Financial Constraints and Firm Dynamics
authors: Giulio Bottazzi; Angelo Secchi; Federico Tamagni
primary_question: How do financial constraints alter mean growth, autoregression, growth-volatility dependence on firm size, shock asymmetry, and the firm-size distribution?
method_family: Generalized Gibrat process; class-specific heteroskedasticity; nonlinear least-squares scaling fits; asymmetric exponential-power shocks
p2_role: PRIMARY_BRIDGE: supplies segment-specific firm-level volatility-size laws and shock-distribution changes; must not be confused with aggregate variance versus population count

title: Financial and Economic Determinants of Firm Default
authors: Giulio Bottazzi; Marco Grazzi; Angelo Secchi; Federico Tamagni
venue_or_series: Journal of Evolutionary Economics / HAL version
primary_question: Which financial and industrial variables distinguish and predict firm default over different horizons?
method_family: Kernel distributions; non-parametric stochastic-equality tests; bootstrap probit; Brier and classification-error assessment; robustness to ratings and Distance to Default
p2_role: COMPOSITION_CAUTION: default and exit generate endogenous population selection and may change the scaling path; not a volatility-aggregation paper

title: Persistence of innovation and patterns of firm growth
primary_question: Do persistent innovators grow faster, and is innovation persistence associated with more persistent firm growth?
method_family: Pre-period innovation-persistence classification; OLS; conditional quantile regressions; autoregressive growth models with interactions
p2_role: SUPPORTING_HETEROGENEITY: innovation status does not determine growth or growth persistence; potential segmentation variable, but no aggregate variance accounting
